turns.text: Which customers bought in every quarter of 2025 and have not bought at all in 2026?

{"sql": "
WITH q2025 AS (
  SELECT cust_id, CAST(strftime('%m', sold_on) AS INTEGER) AS mo, sold_on
  FROM pos_sales
  WHERE sold_on >= '2025-01-01' AND sold_on < '2026-01-01' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL
),
q2025_quarters AS (
  SELECT cust_id,
    CASE WHEN mo BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1
         WHEN mo BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 2
         WHEN mo BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 3
         ELSE 4 END AS q
  FROM q2025
),
per_cust_q AS (
  SELECT cust_id, COUNT(DISTINCT q) AS qcount
  FROM q2025_quarters
  GROUP BY cust_id
),
all_four AS (
  SELECT cust_id FROM per_cust_q WHERE qcount = 4
),
bought_2026 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM pos_sales
  WHERE sold_on >= '2026-01-01' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.cust_id, c.name, c.email
FROM all_four a
LEFT JOIN bought_2026 b ON a.cust_id = b.cust_id
JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id
WHERE b.cust_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.name;
"}
